name: pers_ai_power_global_2026-09-25
objective: maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs
strategy: Bet that the AI capex bottleneck is physical, not narrative: power generation and grid gear (GEV, VRT, NVT), the memory and foundry layer that capex actually buys (MU, TSM, ASML), and the large-cap pharma names with the strongest analyst revision breadth and dated Q4 catalysts (MRK, AMGN, ARGX, WST). CCJ adds uranium supply. Software and OKTA/SNOW/CRWD are the revision-breadth sleeve. I would be wrong if hyperscaler capex pauses (killing GEV/VRT/NVT/MU together), if the Oct 10 MRK or Nov 30 VRTX-type PDUFAs draw CRLs, or if the revision-breadth names mean-revert after their run.

OKLO|net_raises -4, zero revenue, analyst targets dispersed $55-$150
INTC|net_raises 11 of 20 but 36 headlines mostly noise, no dated catalyst
FLUT|net_raises -15 of 15 firms, four guidance cuts in 2026
SERV|net_raises -3 of 3 firms, 2026 revenue guidance cut sharply
IONQ|no revision data, 35x forward sales, chronic ATM dilution
QUBT|gross margin -21%, opex +114% yoy, targets dispersed $10-$32
